description: Emotional gut-punch. Hook = slow vulnerable count or feeling. Body = repetition, raw honesty, single moment dwelling.

hooks: I have watched this scene a hundred times.
There is a moment in {series} I cannot forget.
If you have ever been betrayed by someone you loved, you understand.
I do not have words for what this scene did to me.
{character} broke me in a single frame.

betrayal: And every single time, it breaks me.
And one decision destroyed it all.
If you have ever been there, you know.
sacrifice: Some pain is too big to be loud.
loss: There is no anger in this one.
{character} stopped, and the screen stopped with them.
And we sat there in the silence.
Some scenes are not seen. They are survived.
default: I do not know how to write about this scene.
Some moments have no plot. Only weight.

outros: Tell me which scene broke you.
We do not have to be okay. We just have to feel it.
Send this to whoever shared the silence with you.

hooks: Crying in the club, this scene from {series}.
I have rewatched this clip 50 times today.
{series} did not have to do us like this.
Posting this with tears in my eyes.
If you cried during {series}, this is for you.

default: {character} did NOT deserve any of this.
And we are still not okay.
Every time it reappears in my feed, same reaction.
Streaming has no business hitting this hard.

outros: Drop a heart if you also cried.
Tag whoever made you watch this with them.
We are healing in public, that is fine.

hooks: He visto esta escena cien veces.
Hay un momento de {series} que no olvido.
Si alguien te traicionó como a {character}, entiendes.
No tengo palabras para esta escena.
{character} me rompió en un solo gesto.

default: Y cada vez que la veo, duele igual.
Y todo se cayó en un segundo.
Si lo viviste, ya lo sabes.

outros: ¿A vos también te marcó esta escena?
Dime cuál fue la escena que te quebró.
No siempre estamos bien. Y está bien.
Mándale esto a quien la vio contigo.
